messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant):

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; one of the busiest airports on the West Coast. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the oldest major hubs; key connecting point for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Largest airport in Texas; major hub for American Airlines. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for many carriers including JetBlue and Delta. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Key hub for flights to Asia and the Pacific Rim; major focus city for United Airlines. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for flights to Latin America and the Caribbean; key for American Airlines. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | ORL | Major hub for leisure travel; primary base for Southwest Airlines. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high volume of domestic traffic. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; important for flights to Europe and the Middle East. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit, MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; significant cargo operations. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Dulles, VA | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; key for flights to Europe and the Middle East. |
| Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport | Minneapolis–Saint Paul, MN | MSP | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; important for flights to Canada and the Midwest. |
| Boston Logan International Airport | Boston, MA | BOS | Major hub for Boston‑based airlines like JetBlue; key for flights to Europe. |
| Philadelphia International Airport | Philadelphia, PA | PHL | Major hub for United Airlines; important for flights to the Northeast corridor. |
| Salt Lake City International Airport | Salt Lake City, UT | SLC | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; known for efficient operations. |
| Tampa International Airport | Tampa, FL | TPA | Growing hub for Southwest Airlines; important for leisure travel. |

These airports serve as major hubs for the largest U.S. carriers (American, Delta, United, Southwest) and handle a large share of both domestic and international air traffic.
